## Invoice Number Field

The immutable identity a customer quotes back at you. Like PO Number, the command that issues an invoice stamps it once and nothing recomputes it. It renders in document style (mono, tabular figures) so it reads as a reference wherever it appears.

```ts
import {
  InvoiceNumberField,
  nextInvoiceNumber,
} from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/commerce/invoice-number-field';

invoice.invoiceNumber = nextInvoiceNumber(); // INV-2026-3F9A0C51B2E7
```

`nextInvoiceNumber()` is year-scoped with a twelve-character random tail (48 bits), so even millions of invoices in a year are vanishingly unlikely to share a number. Close Won issues its draft invoice's number with it.

### Example

The linked Invoice INV-2026-114.

### Non-goals

No sequential counter service; a strictly gap-free sequence needs one, and this field doesn't pretend to be it.
